verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LangGraph's graph/node architecture is flexible enough that a developer could write custom nodes to implement validation or blocking logic (e.g., langgraph-comm-10), but there is no documented guardrails feature, safety/validation API, or built-in mechanism to attach input/output content checks. Missing for 10: any first-party guardrails/validation/moderation feature, documented safety hooks, or examples of blocking/transforming unsafe content.
